title: Figure 27: Power transfer by magnetic induction to an implanted BioMEMS retinal prosthesis
description: Artist's rendering of a face in profile wearing glasses with a CCD miniature camera, showing an external transmission coil sending power and data to a receiving coil and chip implanted in the eye. Callouts read "Chip and electrode array connected to Coil," "Receiving Coil for data and power," "Transmission Coil for data and power (wireless transmission)," and "Miniature camera mounted on a pair of glasses." Caption cites the Boston Retinal Implant Project.
